description:
The Monark product brand for a site header: the colour butterfly mark
(28px), a 10px gap, then the product name in Nunito Sans 800 at 18px.
No "by Monark" here; that credit belongs in the footer.

props.name: name
props.description: The product name, e.g. "Splitflow". Set in text, never as an image.

props.name: href
props.description: The site's home page. Default `/`; pass the locale root (`/fr`) on localised sites.

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
The link's accessible name. Defaults to `"{name}, by Monark: home"`
when `name` is a string; pass a translated label on non-English pages.

props.name: LinkComponent
props.description: Link component used for the home link. Default: a plain `<a>`.

description:
The Monark butterfly, colour version (`logo-branded-standalone.svg` from
the brand kit), inlined so it needs no static file. Works on light and
dark backgrounds. Don't recolour or redraw it: the red-to-orange gradient
is part of the logo.

props.name: title
props.description:
Accessible name. Omit it (the default) when the mark sits next to text
that already names the product: the mark is then decorative.
